title: ArchitectureBlueprint derivation inputs (ALUCA-owned)
description: The input contract of `tooling.superversion.architecture_blueprint.derive_blueprint` and of `architecture_blueprint_cli --inputs`. ALUCA's own contract — unlike `architecture_blueprint.schema.json` (the derived IR, byte-identical with Meridian), it is not mirrored. Typed strictly where ALUCA owns a choice that the IR cannot carry; every other key stays open, because the deriver documents it but has never validated it and existing input files must keep loading (ADR-0024).

gold_target.description: Where this domain's gold is materialised (ADR-0024, amended 02.10.2026: lakehouse recommended, warehouse an option). `lakehouse` (default and recommendation) = Delta tables in the lakehouse, built by the notebook transforms the Fabric target has always emitted — byte-identical output to before the field existed. `mlv` = Fabric Materialized Lake Views in a schema-enabled lakehouse: one `CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED LAKE VIEW` per gold product (GA since March 2026 per MS Learn What's new, SQL authoring), refreshed by a schedule (D-529), with the gold transforms of this domain replaced rather than duplicated. `warehouse` = gold in a Fabric Warehouse (T-SQL, multi-table transactions per MS Learn decision-guide-lakehouse-warehouse); accepted here as a choice, refused by the Fabric target until a load path exists (ADR-0024 §8.4). `warehouse_dbt` is a deprecated alias of `lakehouse` (the old, misleading name), read with a warning. The choice is read by the Fabric arch target only; the IR carries no field for it, so it is handed over as the target option `gold_targets`.
